text: Mobile app development involves many important decisions. First, developers must focus on responsive design so that apps work well on different screen sizes and devices. Next, they choose between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one platform and often offer better performance, while cross-platform apps save time and money because one codebase works on both iOS and Android. After development, apps are published through app stores like Google Play or the App Store, where users can download them. Finally, performance matters a lot: fast loading times and smooth operation keep users happy and stop them from deleting the app.
